# CWE-258: Empty Password in Configuration File — Detection in IaC

## Core Weakness to Detect
Any configuration field semantically related to **authentication credentials** (specifically passwords) that is assigned an **empty string value** (`""`, `''`, or a completely blank/null value).

---

## Relevant Keywords, Attributes & Fields

### Password-Specific Field Names
| Category | Keywords / Field Names |
|---|---|
| Generic Password | `password`, `passwd`, `pass`, `pwd`, `passphrase` |
| Prefixed Variants | `db_password`, `admin_password`, `root_password`, `user_password`, `app_password`, `svc_password` |
| Suffixed Variants | `password_value`, `password_string`, `login_password`, `auth_password` |
| Connection Strings | `connectionString`, `connection_string`, `pwd=`, `password=` (inline) |
| Secret/Credential Fields | `secret`, `credential`, `auth_token`, `auth_key`, `service_credential` |

### Authentication Context Fields
```
ldap_password, bind_password, enable_password,
master_password, vault_password, encryption_password,
keystore_password, truststore_password, api_password
```

---

## Detection Patterns

### Pattern 1 — Explicit Empty String Assignment
```
<field_name> = ""
<field_name> = ''
<field_name>: ""
<field_name>: ''
<field_name>=
```

### Pattern 2 — Null/Blank Assignments
```
<field_name> = null
<field_name> = ~
<field_name>:        ← (only whitespace or nothing after colon)
```

### Pattern 3 — Inline Connection String with Empty Password
```
pwd=;
password=;
Password=;
PWD=''
```

---

## Detection Logic Summary

```
IF (
    field_name MATCHES password_keyword_list
    AND
    field_value IS (empty_string OR null OR whitespace_only)
)
THEN FLAG as CWE-258
```

---

## Key Signals & Context Indicators

| Signal | Explanation |
|---|---|
| Password field present but value is `""` or `''` | Direct match |
| Password field declared but **no value assigned** | Implicit empty |
| Inline connection/DSN string with `pwd=;` or `password=;` | Embedded empty credential |
| Authentication block with username populated but password empty | Asymmetric credential configuration |
| Environment variable reference is missing but field exists | Misconfiguration leaving password blank |

---

## Related Fields to Cross-Check
- `username` / `user` / `login` — if populated while `password` is empty, it is a strong indicator
- `auth_enabled: true` alongside empty password — contradictory and flaggable
- `require_password: false` — related misconfiguration (CWE-260 territory but contextually linked)

---

## Summary

To detect **CWE-258** in IaC scripts, scan for any attribute or field whose **name semantically implies a password or credential**, and verify whether its **assigned value resolves to an empty, null, or blank string**. The combination of an authentication-related field name with an empty value is the definitive indicator of this weakness.

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

password_pattern := "(?i).*(password|passwd|passphrase|pwd|credential|auth_token|auth_key|bind_pass|ldap_pass|master_pass|vault_pass|encryption_pass|keystore_pass|truststore_pass|api_pass|activationkey|activation_key).*"

is_empty_value(value) {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    value.value == ""
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]

    regex.match(password_pattern, attr.name)
    is_empty_value(attr.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_empty_pass",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Empty password in configuration - Authentication fields should not have empty passwords. (CWE-258)"
    }
}

    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    vars := glitch_lib.all_variables(parent)
    variable := vars[_]

    regex.match(password_pattern, variable.name)
    is_empty_value(variable.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_empty_pass",
        "element": variable,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Empty password in configuration - Authentication fields should not have empty passwords. (CWE-258)"
    }
}

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

password_pattern := "(?i).*(password|passwd|passphrase|pwd|credential|auth_token|auth_key|bind_pass|ldap_pass|master_pass|vault_pass|encryption_pass|keystore_pass|truststore_pass|api_pass|secret|key).*"

is_empty_string(value) {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    value.value == ""
}

has_empty_ref(value, parent) {
    walk(value, [_, n])
    n.ir_type == "VariableReference"
    ref_name := n.value
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == ref_name
    is_empty_string(attr.value)
}

has_empty_ref(value, parent) {
    walk(value, [_, n])
    n.ir_type == "VariableReference"
    ref_name := n.value
    vars := glitch_lib.all_variables(parent)
    var := vars[_]
    var.name == ref_name
    is_empty_string(var.value)
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match(password_pattern, attr.name)
    is_empty_string(attr.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_empty_pass",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Empty password in configuration - Authentication fields should not have empty passwords. (CWE-258)"
    }
}

    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    vars := glitch_lib.all_variables(parent)
    variable := vars[_]
    regex.match(password_pattern, variable.name)
    is_empty_string(variable.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_empty_pass",
        "element": variable,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Empty password in configuration - Authentication fields should not have empty passwords. (CWE-258)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)

    regex.match(password_pattern, attr.name)
    not is_empty_string(attr.value)
    has_empty_ref(attr.value, parent)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_empty_pass",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Empty password in configuration - Authentication fields should not have empty passwords. (CWE-258)"
